correctness.rationale: Exact exhaustive 27,931-face enumeration, all mod-2 boundary ranks, boundary-composition checks and Euler characteristic establish rational H4 dimension 960 and vanishing of all other reduced rational homology. A transitive finite tournament has a canonical order, so every setwise invariant simplex under an automorphism is pointwise fixed. Reduced Hopf traces for all 465 affine symmetries are 960,-1,0; comparison with the regular and augmentation characters plus semisimplicity proves the precise Q[G]-isomorphism and its corollaries. Runnable verifier and output included.

value.rationale: A canonical 31-vertex Paley tournament lies beyond the fully classified 27-vertex census, and 960-dimensional homology motivates studying its arithmetic automorphisms. The complete natural 465-element character and two globally invariant fourth-homology classes are nontrivial exact information not determined by the already published nonequivariant wedge type. No broad unproved downstream theorem is claimed.
